entities.summary: John Andersson Klingberg is a Swedish professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the San Jose Sharks of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted 131st overall in the 2010 NHL entry draft by the Dallas Stars. He is the younger brother of Carl Klingberg.
